title: Retain the reported failure of enabling both frame directions forever
statement: The source companion analyzes the two-frame {I,CNOT} replacement with BOTH target Hamiltonians enabled continuously and separate positive equal-rate resets. Its four-state cycle has stationary population equally split between the two frame classes, so a deterministic late target cannot have arbitrarily small unfinished probability. This is a failure of that specific free-running replacement, not a general impossibility theorem for autonomous clocks or locally coupled command distributors.
